patterns.message: Import a feature through its barrel: @/features/<name>. Inside a feature, use relative ./ imports.
Import a workspace package through its barrel (e.g. @repo/client); export what's missing there. Tests may reach into src/.
Don't climb more than one folder up — use @/ for anything further, ./ for siblings. One level up is allowed so a sub-domain folder (records/versions/) can reach its parent feature.
